title: The Love That Changes Everything
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he explores what it means to be a church that loves with reckless abandon, and discover the transformative power of living out God's love in every area of your life. This sermon series will challenge you to re-examine your priorities and ask the hard questions: what are we doing as a church if we're not loving people with God's love? Find out how to make your church an oasis of love that impacts the lives of those around you.
